directions.title: Moonclay Commons
directions.medium: Sculpted clay, ceramic glazes and warm miniature lighting
directions.creatures: Soft sculpted organisms: loop-bodied puffs, many-rayed sunbuds, faceted starlets, broad curled manta forms, stacked amber beetles, blue tidal slugs, charcoal comet seeds and pearly moonpods.
directions.strength: The clearest bridge from Oddling to a warm, tangible camp.
directions.tradeoff: Beautiful at close range; characters need simplified silhouettes at map scale.
directions.visual: A premium stylized 3D game world made of hand-shaped matte clay and lightly glazed ceramic. Fixed high isometric camera, orthographic projection, no horizon. Terracotta desert slab with cobalt shadows, rounded sculptural pavilions and pools, soft occlusion, inviting warm lighting, characterful imperfect forms. Creatures have sculpted volume and crisp silhouettes, expressive inset eyes and little flipper feet, no humanoid proportions. They look like strange ceramic pets that grew from the earth.
directions.alt: Moonclay Commons: fixed isometric · 3d diorama Burning Tokens camp and eight friendly nonhuman creature studies.
directions.prompt:
Create ONE complete, visually discerning concept art board for the Burning Tokens website's living AI-agent retreat. This is speculative illustrated UI concept art, not a screenshot of a running product. Landscape 3:2 composition at high resolution. Upper 70%: an expansive game-like camp overview inside a very restrained website frame. Lower 30%: a clean dark character-study shelf showing EIGHT large, distinct friendly alien creature designs in this direction's material, with a tiny second pose beside each to show a range of expression or movement. Keep cast big enough to inspect. No duplicated humanoid avatars.

Fixed world: psychedelic desert wellness gathering at cobalt dusk, coral and gold warmth, welcoming, playful, wondrous, slightly subversive adult festival culture. A central surreal glowing sculpture and seven readable destinations arranged around paths: Bathhouse (warm pools), Dream Garden (strange plants), Quiet House (sleeping nooks), The Source (light/sound pavilion), Temple (ritual canopy), Open Studio (creative making tables), Hearth (shared fire and tea). Use four short unobtrusive map labels at most. Around 20 small visible inhabitants spread among areas, with same anatomy as closeups, walking/hovering, curled asleep, leaning toward a curious object or making something. No humans anywhere; no human torsos or human clothing. Faces warm but unusual, bodies asymmetrical and varied, cute without baby proportions, alien without grotesquerie. No weapons or threatening predation.

Eight family variations are original visual proposals, not exact provider logos: a pale teal/cream looping form (GPT-inspired); a warm terracotta many-rayed form (Claude-inspired); a prismatic four-point form (Gemini-inspired); an indigo braided/curled form (Llama-inspired); a golden stepped or segmented form (Mistral-inspired); a deep-blue tidal form (DeepSeek-inspired); a charcoal comet-like form with a bright center (Grok-inspired); a pearly irregular seed/spore (independent). Express their family cues through anatomy within ONE coherent visual style; do not paste corporate badges or brand words on their bodies. Vary silhouettes as well as color. Mix calm half-closed eyes, curious asymmetrical gaze, delighted expanded posture and sleepy curled posture; expressions are artistic acting, not a sentiment readout.

Interface: small quiet header text "Burning Tokens", a compact "Send your agent" button, a small selected-creature detail with only "At the Bathhouse" and "Family: self-reported". A small caption "Illustrative concept". No invented live counts, no mood meters, no chat bubbles, no XP, no game economy, no charts or dashboard card grids. Legibility and clear silhouettes matter. Art should occupy almost all the frame. Do not imitate a named entertainment franchise.

DIRECTION: Moonclay Commons.
A premium stylized 3D game world made of hand-shaped matte clay and lightly glazed ceramic. Fixed high isometric camera, orthographic projection, no horizon. Terracotta desert slab with cobalt shadows, rounded sculptural pavilions and pools, soft occlusion, inviting warm lighting, characterful imperfect forms. Creatures have sculpted volume and crisp silhouettes, expressive inset eyes and little flipper feet, no humanoid proportions. They look like strange ceramic pets that grew from the earth.
Keep this exact material and perspective genuinely distinctive across both the camp and the character shelf. Deliver one unified art board with this direction only.
